resources.string: MiriquidiHub is free software (GPL-3.0), ad-free and without tracking. It is developed in spare time. A voluntary donation supports further development and maintenance of the app.\n\nThe donation is handled in your browser via the Buy Me a Coffee website. All features of the app remain fully usable regardless.

Ad-free, no tracking, free under GPL-3.0 and developed in spare time. If you’d like to support me in the development of MiriquidiHub and value my work, I’d be delighted to receive a donation of your choice via buymeacoffee.com.

The app is, of course, fully usable even without a donation.
